note: Meanings are drawn from the medieval rune poems and from modern divinatory practice (20th-century authors). Reversal conventions vary between teachers.

runes.name: Fehu
runes.meaning: Fehu is mobile wealth: the cattle that gave early communities their security. It speaks of resources that flow, grow and must be shared.
runes.upright: Income, opportunity and creative energy are available. Use resources well, share them, and a new venture can prosper.
runes.reversed: Loss, stagnation or greed. Resources are blocked or being hoarded; check where your energy is leaking.
runes.affirmation: I attract abundance and use it wisely.

runes.name: Uruz
runes.meaning: The aurochs was a huge wild ox. Uruz is untamed vital force, endurance and the drive to grow.
runes.upright: Physical and inner strength are high. Take on a challenge, build stamina and trust your will.
runes.reversed: Weakness, missed chances or misdirected force. Rest, rebuild, and avoid forcing outcomes.
runes.affirmation: I have the strength to meet what comes.

runes.name: Thurisaz
runes.meaning: Thurisaz is the thorn and the giant: a defensive force that can guard or wound. It marks a gateway where you must act with awareness.
runes.upright: Defend your boundaries and pause before reacting. A decisive step is possible, but think before you strike.
runes.reversed: Vulnerability or impulsive conflict. Beware of rash words and avoid walking into danger unprepared.
runes.affirmation: I set firm boundaries and act with awareness.

runes.name: Ansuz
runes.meaning: Ansuz is the divine breath and spoken word, linked to Odin and to the power of speech, poetry and insight.
runes.upright: A message, teaching or inspiration arrives. Listen carefully and speak clearly and honestly.
runes.reversed: Miscommunication, deceit or ignored advice. Check your words and your sources.
runes.affirmation: I speak truth and listen for wisdom.

runes.name: Raido
runes.meaning: Raido is the road and the ride, both an actual journey and the rhythm of a life moving in order.
runes.upright: Travel, progress and a clear plan. Keep to the right path and the right pace.
runes.reversed: Delay, disruption or a wrong turn. Rethink the route before you continue.
runes.affirmation: I move forward with purpose and rhythm.

runes.name: Kenaz
runes.meaning: Kenaz is the torch: light in the dark, the fire of craft and the flash of understanding.
runes.upright: Insight, creativity and skill. Something becomes clear, so shape it into something useful.
runes.reversed: Fading light, creative block or burnout. Rest the flame and tend it gently.
runes.affirmation: I bring light to what I create.

runes.name: Gebo
runes.meaning: Gebo is the gift and the bond it creates. Giving and receiving in balance holds relationships together.
runes.upright: A fair exchange, a generous gift or a partnership. Give freely and accept gratefully.
runes.affirmation: I give and receive in balance.

runes.name: Wunjo
runes.meaning: Wunjo is joy and belonging, the contentment of being among your own people and in tune with your life.
runes.upright: Happiness, success and harmony. Enjoy what is good and share it.
runes.reversed: Sorrow, isolation or delay of joy. Reconnect with people and things that restore you.
runes.affirmation: I welcome joy into my life.

runes.name: Hagalaz
runes.meaning: Hagalaz is hail: a sudden force from outside that destroys and clears. Its damage often makes room for new growth.
runes.upright: Unexpected disruption you cannot control. Stay steady, accept the change and look for what it clears.
runes.affirmation: I stay steady through change.

runes.name: Nauthiz
runes.meaning: Nauthiz is need-fire: friction and scarcity that force resourcefulness and show what truly matters.
runes.upright: A period of constraint. Know your real needs, be patient and work with what you have.
runes.reversed: Deprivation or struggle made worse by denial. Ask for help and meet real needs.
runes.affirmation: I meet my needs with patience and courage.

runes.name: Isa
runes.meaning: Isa is ice: a halt in motion that can preserve, protect or block.
runes.upright: A pause or standstill. Conserve energy, wait and use the time to see clearly.
runes.affirmation: I rest in stillness and wait for the thaw.

runes.name: Jera
runes.meaning: Jera is the turning year and the harvest that follows the planting. Results come in their season.
runes.upright: Patient effort is paid back. Trust natural timing and enjoy the harvest.
runes.affirmation: I trust the cycles and enjoy the harvest.

runes.name: Eihwaz
runes.meaning: Eihwaz is the yew, an evergreen tied to endurance and to the passage between life and death.
runes.upright: Persistence through difficulty. A deep change is underway and your roots will hold.
runes.affirmation: I endure and grow stronger.

runes.name: Perthro
runes.meaning: The original meaning of Perthro is uncertain, and the rune poems say little. It is usually read as the lot-cup or dice box, representing fate and the unknown.
runes.upright: Hidden information, luck and surprise. Be open to what is revealed.
runes.reversed: Secrets, stagnation or unwelcome news. Do not gamble on guesses.
runes.affirmation: I accept mystery and trust the process.

runes.name: Algiz
runes.meaning: Algiz is often read as an elk's antlers or an open hand: a protective sign and a link between earth and sky.
runes.upright: You are protected. Stay alert, trust your instincts and ask for support.
runes.reversed: Vulnerability or poor judgement. Check your defences and avoid risks you cannot see.
runes.affirmation: I am protected and guided.

runes.name: Sowilo
runes.meaning: Sowilo is the sun: energy, victory and a clear direction.
runes.upright: Success, clarity and renewed energy. Follow your purpose.
runes.affirmation: I walk in light and succeed.

runes.name: Tiwaz
runes.meaning: Tiwaz is the sky god Tyr, linked to law and justice and to the sacrifice of his hand to bind Fenrir.
runes.upright: Courage and integrity. Do the right thing even at a cost; fight fairly.
runes.reversed: Injustice, cowardice or a loss of direction. Review your motives and your honesty.
runes.affirmation: I act with courage and honour.

runes.name: Berkano
runes.meaning: Berkano is the birch, a pioneer tree of early spring, linked to birth, fertility and care.
runes.upright: New growth, a fresh start and nurturing. Care for what is beginning.
runes.reversed: Stalled growth or family worries. Look for the neglected area that needs attention.
runes.affirmation: I nurture new beginnings.

runes.name: Ehwaz
runes.meaning: Ehwaz is the horse and the partnership between horse and rider, based on trust and teamwork.
runes.upright: Steady progress through cooperation. Trust your partner and move forward together.
runes.reversed: Restlessness or mistrust. A change is unsettled, so slow down and rebuild trust.
runes.affirmation: I move forward with trust.

runes.name: Mannaz
runes.meaning: Mannaz represents humanity and your place within it, both as an individual and as part of a group.
runes.upright: Self-knowledge and cooperation. Draw on community and share your abilities.
runes.reversed: Isolation or conflict with others. Check how you relate to the people around you.
runes.affirmation: I am part of something greater.

runes.name: Laguz
runes.meaning: Laguz is water: feeling, intuition and the hidden currents of life.
runes.upright: Trust intuition and go with the flow. Dreams and feelings are guides.
runes.reversed: Confusion, fear or emotional overwhelm. Find solid ground before deciding.
runes.affirmation: I trust my intuition and flow with life.

runes.name: Ingwaz
runes.meaning: Ingwaz is linked to the god Ing (Freyr). It shows energy stored and ready to be released, a seed at the point of germination.
runes.upright: A phase is completing and a new one is ready. Gather your strength, then act.
runes.affirmation: I complete what I start and welcome what is next.

runes.name: Dagaz
runes.meaning: Dagaz is day, the moment when light replaces darkness and a threshold is crossed.
runes.upright: A breakthrough or turning point. Welcome the new dawn.
runes.affirmation: I awaken to a new dawn.

runes.name: Othala
runes.meaning: Othala is ancestral land and inheritance: what is passed down, and where you truly belong.
runes.upright: Home, family and roots. Honour what you inherit and secure what is yours.
runes.reversed: Clinging to the past or a family dispute. Let go of what no longer serves you.
runes.affirmation: I honour my roots and make a home.
